name: _placeholder.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  media-figure/_placeholder.scss — the render-placeholder SVG layer — aspect-ratio slot before media loads, plus per-context sizing.
//  Imported by media-figure.scss (manifest) — applies INSIDE the
//  <media-figure> shadow root; not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── SVG placeholder — maintains aspect ratio before image loads ───────────────
// The transparent SVG img sets the intrinsic size; all media layers are
// absolutely positioned on top of it.
// Default: on mobile, stretch full-width of host. On tablet+, use natural
// SVG dimensions (set via width/height attributes) so media never exceeds
// the source resolution.
.render-placeholder {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  height: auto;
  // Mobile: full-width so the media fills the screen — but never past
  // the file's own pixel width (--mf-natural-w, published by render):
  // a small source keeps its native box instead of stretching to the
  // viewport, which is what used to upscale tiny media everywhere.
  width: 100%;
  max-width: min(100%, var(--mf-natural-w));

  @include layout-768() {
    // Tablet+: respect the SVG's intrinsic width/height attributes
    // so small images are not scaled up beyond their native resolution.
    width: auto;
    max-width: min(100%, var(--mf-natural-w));
  }
}

@supports selector(:host-context(*)) {
  :host-context(.internal-extra-item) .render-placeholder {
    position: relative;
    // Carousel strip contract: every slide shares the --mf-h strip height
    // so media always fills the row — clamped at the file's own height
    // (--mf-natural-h) so a small source shrinks its slide rather than
    // upscaling. Width stays aspect-driven (auto → height × intrinsic
    // ratio) capped by --mf-w on mobile/tablet and --mf-max-w (or the
    // viewport gutter calc) on desktop — and by --mf-natural-w — with a
    // 320px floor at ≥375px viewports so very tall media keep a usable
    // touch target instead of collapsing to slivers.
    height: min(var(--mf-h, calc(70vh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)})), var(--mf-natural-h));
    height: min(var(--mf-h, calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)})), var(--mf-natural-h));
    width: auto;
    max-width: min(var(--mf-w, calc(90vw - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)})), var(--mf-natural-w));

    @include layout-375() {
      // Floor capped at the file's own width — a sub-320px source keeps
      // its natural box instead of being stretched past its pixels.
      min-width: min(#{to-rem(320)}, var(--mf-natural-w));
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      max-width: min(
        var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl * 2)} - #{to-rem(48)})),
        var(--mf-natural-w)
      );
    }
  }
}

// When inside .internal-extra-item context (carousel slides): the strip
// height is pinned to --mf-h so every slide fills the carousel row, width
// is aspect-driven (auto → height × intrinsic ratio) capped by --mf-w on
// mobile/tablet and by --mf-max-w (or the viewport-gutter calc: item
// padding + 24px margins per side) on desktop, and floored at 320px on
// ≥375px viewports so tall media keep a usable touch target instead of
// collapsing to slivers. The transparent placeholder only sizes the box —
// the real media layers cover-crop it, so a floored/capped width never
// distorts the image. These vars cross the shadow boundary from
// internals.scss / carousel-host.scss.
:host(.internal-extra-item) .render-placeholder,
:host([classes*='internal-extra-item']) .render-placeholder {
  position: relative;
  // Same strip-height contract as the :host-context twin above, with the
  // natural-size clamps: --mf-natural-h bounds the strip height and
  // --mf-natural-w composes into every width cap, so the slide can be
  // *smaller* than the uniform strip but never larger than the file.
  height: min(var(--mf-h, calc(70vh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)})), var(--mf-natural-h));
  height: min(var(--mf-h, calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)})), var(--mf-natural-h));
  width: auto;
  max-width: min(var(--mf-w, calc(90vw - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)})), var(--mf-natural-w));

  @include layout-375() {
    min-width: min(#{to-rem(320)}, var(--mf-natural-w));
  }

  @include layout-768() {
    height: min(var(--mf-h, calc(70vh - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)})), var(--mf-natural-h));
    height: min(var(--mf-h, calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)})), var(--mf-natural-h));
    max-width: min(var(--mf-w, calc(90vw - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)})), var(--mf-natural-w));
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    height: min(var(--mf-h, #{to-rem($space-7xl)}), var(--mf-natural-h));
    // --mf-max-w is only declared for landscape items — regular slides get
    // the viewport-gutter cap (padding + 24px margin clearance per side).
    max-width: min(
      var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl * 2)} - #{to-rem(48)})),
      var(--mf-natural-w)
    );
  }

  @include layout-1440() {
    height: min(var(--mf-h, #{to-rem($space-8xl)}), var(--mf-natural-h));
    max-width: min(
      var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl * 2)} - #{to-rem(48)})),
      var(--mf-natural-w)
    );
  }

  @include layout-2560() {
    height: min(var(--mf-h, #{to-rem($space-9xl)}), var(--mf-natural-h));
    max-width: min(
      var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-4xl * 2)} - #{to-rem(48)})),
      var(--mf-natural-w)
    );
  }
}

// Landscape items keep the same fixed --mf-h strip height as every other
// slide — only the width cap relaxes to viewport-gutter margins so wide
// media can stretch across most of the viewport. max-height must NOT be
// re-declared here: with an explicit `height` the max-* constraint would
// still clamp the used height and re-introduce the ragged-height bug.
:host(.internal-extra-item.landscape) .render-placeholder,
:host([classes*='internal-extra-item'][classes*='landscape']) .render-placeholder {
  @include layout-1024() {
    max-width: min(var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl)})), var(--mf-natural-w));
  }

  @include layout-1280() {
    max-width: min(var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-4xl)})), var(--mf-natural-w));
  }

  @include layout-1440() {
    max-width: min(var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-7xl)})), var(--mf-natural-w));
  }

  @include layout-1920() {
    max-width: min(var(--mf-max-w, calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-6xl)})), var(--mf-natural-w));
  }
}
